title: Froggy Throwables
description: This Mod allows you to throw any item by holding the drop key.
body:
# Froggy Throwables

## What does it do?
This mod lets you throw items instead of dropping them when you hold the drop key.
[Default is Q]

When the thrown item hits anything, it'll drop back into an item.

### Default Throwable Items

These can now only be thrown through the mods method:
- Snowballs
- Eggs [White, Brown and Blue]
- Ender Pearls
- Eyes of Ender
- Wind Charges
- Expirience Bottles
- Splash Potions
- Lingering Potions

### Unique Functions
- Fire Charge: Throws as a small fire ball.

### Entity Model Featurs compatible
